slides.title: Mahagauri, radiant and calm
slides.sub: The eighth form of Durga, worshipped on Ashtami

slides.title: Purity and forgiveness
slides.body: After long austerities the Goddess regains a radiant, fair complexion. Dressed in white, calm and gentle, Mahagauri stands for purity and forgiveness.

slides.title: White, on a bull
slides.body: She rides a bull and holds a trident and a damaru, the small drum. Ashtami is one of the most important days everywhere: kanya pujan in many north Indian homes, anjali and Sandhi Puja in Bengal.

slides.text:
श्वेते वृषे समारूढा श्वेताम्बरधरा शुचिः ।
महागौरी शुभं दद्यान्महादेवप्रमोददा ॥
slides.translit: Shvete vrishe samarudha shvetambaradhara shuchih, mahagauri shubham dadyan mahadevapramodada
slides.meaning: May Mahagauri, pure, robed in white and riding a white bull, the joy of Mahadeva, grant what is good.

slides.title: Sandhi Puja: 48 minutes, 108 lamps
slides.sub: Where Ashtami ends and Navami begins

slides.title: 24 + 24 minutes
slides.body: Sandhi means junction. Sandhi Puja takes the last 24 minutes of Ashtami and the first 24 of Navami: 48 minutes in all, counted by the lunar day (tithi), not the calendar day.

slides.title: When is it this year?
slides.body: Ashtami is Mon 19 Oct, Navami Tue 20 Oct. The junction may fall in the afternoon, late at night or before dawn, on either date. Ask your puja committee or check a reliable local panjika.

slides.title: Durga as Chamunda
slides.body: In the Devi Mahatmya, the fierce Chamunda slays the demon generals Chanda and Munda. Bengali tradition places that battle at this junction, so the goddess is worshipped as Chamunda.

slides.title: 108 lotuses, 108 lamps
items: A symbolic ash gourd, sugarcane or banana

slides.title: Rama's 108th lotus
slides.body: In Krittibas's Bengali Ramayana, Rama gathers 108 blue lotuses for Durga. She hides one to test him, and he resolves to offer his own eye. She stops him and grants him victory.

slides.line: At the junction: dhak, conch and ulu rise together

slides.title: Ask the time. Arrive early.
slides.ask: Send it to the family group

caption.en:
Sandhi Puja 2026 in Kolkata: the 48 minutes at the heart of Durga Puja 🪔

It is the junction where Ashtami ends and Navami begins: the last 24 minutes of one lunar day and the first 24 of the next. The goddess is worshipped as Chamunda, with 108 lotuses and 108 lamps. For many Bengalis it is the most powerful moment of the puja.

This year Maha Ashtami is Monday 19 October and Maha Navami Tuesday 20 October. The junction can fall in the afternoon, late at night or before dawn, so the clock time comes from the panjika your priest follows. Almanacs can differ slightly, and a time from another year or city won't help.

The pandal fills well before the junction, so get there early.

Send this to whoever runs the family's Ashtami plan 👇
